title: The Window Over Which Claims Loading a ShieldCare Excess Are Counted
content:
The claims that load the excess on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan are counted over a window,
and which window turns on whether the plan is one that puts its cover back at each anniversary and on
whether such a reinstatement stands recorded on it.

| What the plan shows | The window the claims are counted over |
| --- | --- |
| the plan is one that puts its cover back at each anniversary, and such an entry stands on it | the claims are counted from the month the cover was most recently put back |
| the plan puts its cover back at each anniversary, and no such entry stands on it | the claims are counted over the last 12 months |
| every other plan | the claims are counted over the whole term of the plan |

### Points of judgement

A plan that does not put its cover back at each anniversary reaches the third row whatever its history,
and the window is then the whole term of the plan as sold. On a plan that does put its cover back, the
window opens at the most recent reinstatement where one stands recorded, and is the last 12 months
where none does.

### Cases on hypothetical records

| Plan puts cover back at each anniversary | Reinstatement recorded | Window counted |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no | none | the whole term of the plan |
| yes | none | the last 12 months |
| yes | 5 months ago | from the month of that reinstatement |
